scope: Public original evidence on restaurant AI menu cross-selling; no contact, login, payment or submission

sources.title: Offline Evaluation using Interactions to Decide Cross-selling Recommendations Algorithm for Online Food Delivery
sources.author: Manchit Madan
sources.inspection: Full six-page text read; key evidence in page 2 section 3 and page 5 table 1 / section 4.3.2

interpretation_controls: ABV percent changes, not percentage points
Order Share is not total order volume
Offline sample is not online experiment sample
Deployment duration is not controlled follow-up duration
Nonsignificance is not proof of no effect
